label: Actual cover/nonparthood versus exact fusion/full nonoverlap
term: actual cover/nonparthood versus exact fusion/full nonoverlap
resolution: The new cover condition retains actual existence and membership inclusion but omits Fusion.noextra; it is not a reconstructed fusion or a least upper bound. The new causal exclusion omits full common-part nonoverlap, retaining only NOT cause≤effect. Existing old-to-new helpers preserve the SAME Ontic, world, order, causal relation, selected family and actual candidate. Other four population-route premises are unchanged. No converse, strict separation, minimum-premise theorem, source truth or independently adequate application follows. Some bare actual NE is the endpoint, not necessity of a selected cause, a concrete/unique/underived source or God. The original CF2/MF2 and source-scope records remain unchanged. Strict causal coverage is still a universal input; a default inference inside scoped NoNE is not automatically warranted by source defeasible evidence.
